title: Train the pathway, deposit the computation: a two-probe dissociation of component ownership in transformer emergence — code and data
description: Code and recorded result logs for a two-probe dissociation of component ownership in transformer emergence. Freeze probes ask which sub-network must be trained; mean-ablation probes ask where the trained computation sits. Arms are synthetic Boolean degree-staircase targets and in-context induction streams. Experiment code and per-run logs only; manuscript sources are not included. Code: MIT; result logs: CC-BY-4.0. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21020348.
